protocol: VIIRS S-NPP and MODIS both observed Argentina from 2012 onward. In those overlap years the true S-NPP count is known, so each harmonization method can be scored by hiding VIIRS and predicting it from MODIS alone, which is exactly what the method has to do for 2000 to 2011.

Models are trained on 2012 to 2017: both sensors were on their nominal orbits, and the MODIS product version matches the one used for the years being reconstructed. The MODIS version and its static-source flagging change in 2018, so later years are used only as a forward check.

Four tests. Leave one year out: train on five of the six overlap years, predict the sixth. Backcast: train on 2015 to 2017, predict 2012 to 2014, the closest analogue to reconstructing earlier years. Leave one region out: train without one of Argentina's five macro-regions and predict it. Forward: train on 2012 to 2017 and predict 2018 to 2021, across the MODIS version change.
Every score is computed on predictions for data the method never saw. Counts are compared at four scales: 0.1 degree cells, 1 degree blocks, provinces and the whole country, by month.

methods.label: No harmonization
methods.description: MODIS Terra plus Aqua counts as they are. This is what a plain splice of the two records shows before 2012.

methods.label: National ratio
methods.description: One VIIRS-to-MODIS ratio for the whole country, multiplied by the MODIS count.

methods.label: Local ratio
methods.description: A VIIRS-to-MODIS ratio for each cell, pulled toward its 1 degree block and then the national ratio when the cell has few detections.

methods.label: Transfer model
methods.description: Gradient-boosted trees that predict the S-NPP count of each cell and month from MODIS counts, fire radiative power, the share of small and night detections, neighbouring cells, season, position and the cell's past VIIRS-to-MODIS behaviour. It can predict small fires that only VIIRS sees.

methods.label: Blend
methods.description: The average of the transfer model and the local ratio, with equal weights fixed in advance. The two err in different places, so their average is steadier.

tests.label: Leave one region out
tests.description: Five folds: Northwest, Northeast, Cuyo, Pampas, Patagonia.

tests.label: Forward
tests.description: Train 2012 to 2017, predict 2018 to 2021 (new MODIS version).

metric_defs.log_rmse: Typical error in log space: the root mean square of log(1 + predicted) minus log(1 + actual). 0.10 is roughly a 10% error.
metric_defs.bias_pct: Total predicted minus total actual, as a percent of actual. Negative means the method undercounts.
metric_defs.spearman: Rank correlation between predicted and actual counts across all region-months.
metric_defs.season_r: Within each region and year, the rank correlation of the twelve monthly values: does the method get the shape of the fire season right?
metric_defs.peak_match: Share of region-years where the method picks the same peak month as VIIRS.
metric_defs.anomaly_agreement: Share of region-months given the same anomaly class (below, normal, above, far above) from the predicted and the actual series.
